lead: A placeholder while the assistant's reply hasn't started: three dots, a pulsing dot, a spinner, or a skeleton of an avatar and a few lines of text. Screen readers read the status text once; everything drawn is decoration, and nothing moves with "reduced motion".

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.dots: dots: the container of the three dots and each dot (decorative, `aria-hidden`)
styling.skeleton: skeleton: the avatar placeholder, the container of the text placeholders and each placeholder bar
